description: This file contains shell script test cases for Git push operations, including various push scenarios such as normal push, atomic push, non-fast-forward push, forced push, and cleanup. It uses Git commands and custom testing functions to verify correct behavior of Git push with different options and ref manipulations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided shell commands and verifying their output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, executing the provided commands and confirming they fail as expected.
